schema_documentation:
All 20 keys present on 100% of records (single key-set, count 405/405 in stats). Every value is `str` or JSON `null` — no dicts, no lists, no JSON-encoded strings. Non-empty rates below are from my own stratified sample (first 250 records of each of the 10 shards, n=2,500 = 17.5% of the corpus).

| key | type | non-empty | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | str | 100.0% | full PDF-extracted body; contains embedded `<table>` HTML |
| `title` | str | 100.0% | Greek thesis/document title |
| `abstract` | str/null | 79.6% | Greek abstract, clean repository metadata (not OCR) |
| `description` | str/null | 98.3% | inconsistent: sometimes = abstract, sometimes just the author name |
| `description_full` | str/null | 98.3% | bibliographic notes + abstract, fields joined by ` \|\|\| ` |
| `information` | str/null | 85.0% | shelf-mark / degree note, ` ; `-joined |
| `subjects` | str/null | 76.7% | subject keywords, ` ; `-joined, mixed EL/EN/FR |
| `creator` | str/null | 99.9% | author, "Επώνυμο, Όνομα" |
| `contributors` | str/null | 98.0% | supervisor + committee + department, ` ; `-joined |
| `supervisor` | str/null | 85.1% | supervisor name |
| `issue_date` | str | 100.0% | "YYYY" or "YYYY-MM" (1975–2025 in stats enum) |
| `type` | str | 100.0% | e.g. "Electronic Thesis or Dissertation ; Text" (2250/2500), "Text ; Πανηγυρικός Λόγος" (34), "Text ; Ομιλία" (16) |
| `publisher` | str/null | 99.9% | Πανεπιστήμιο Μακεδονίας 1704, …Οικονομικών και Κοινωνικών Επιστημών 586(+114 with trailing "."), ΑΒΣΘ 44, Βουλή των Ελλήνων 40 (per 2,500) |
| `department` | str/null | 85.2% | department / MSc programme |
| `collection_name` | str | 100.0% | DSpace collection, e.g. "Τμήμα Εφαρμοσμένης Πληροφορικής  (Δ)" |
| `title_alt` | str/null | 14.0% | EN/FR title |
| `rights` | str/null | 53.2% | licence name ` ; ` URL, or the "δεν έχει αποδεσμευτεί" note (102/2500 = 4.1%) |
| `relations` | str/null | 2.1% | related items — effectively unusable |
| `handle_url` | str | 100.0% | https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/handle/… (100% of 600 checked) |
| `pdf_url` | str | 100.0% | direct PDF link |
